title: 1893 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship

{{Short description|none}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox Hurling All-Ireland | year = 1893 | image = | dates = 5 November 1893 – 21 June 1894 | teams = 5 | connacht = | munster = Cork | leinster = Kilkenny | ulster = | matches = 2 | poty = | team = Cork | titles = 3rd | captain = [[John Murphy (Cork hurler)|John Murphy]] | manager = | team2 = Kilkenny | captain2 = Dan Whelan | manager2 = | totalgoals = 11 (5.50 per game) | totalpoints = 13 (6.50 per game) | topscorer = | previous = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1892|1892]] | next = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1894|1894]] }} The '''1893 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the seventh staging of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]]'s premier [[inter-county]] [[hurling]] tournament. The championship ran from 5 November 1893 to 21 June 1894. [[Cork GAA|Cork]] were the [[1892 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|defending champions]].{{cite news|url=https://www.echolive.ie/corksport/arid-40163136.html|title=We had to bring on a 61-year-old to make up the numbers... Redmonds chairman explains why one of Cork's oldest clubs is going out of existence|publisher=Echo Live|date=20 September 2018|accessdate=30 July 2026|first=|last=}}{{cite news|url=https://www.irishexaminer.com/sport/gaa/arid-30870483.html|title=Historic Cork club Redmonds set to shut its doors|publisher=Irish Examiner|date=21 September 2018|accessdate=30 July 2026|first=|last=}}{{cite news|url=https://hoganstand.com/County/UK/Article/Index/290575|title=Famous Cork GAA club to disband|publisher=Hogan Stand|date=21 September 2018|accessdate=30 July 2026|first=|last=}} The [[#All-Ireland final|All-Ireland final]] was played at the [[Phoenix Park]] in [[Dublin]] on 21 June 1894 between Cork and [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]], in what was their first ever meeting in the All-Ireland final. Cork won the match by 6–08 to 0–02 to become the first team to retain the title. It was their third All-Ireland title in four years.{{cite news|url=https://www.echolive.ie/corksport/arid-41431522.html|title=Blackrock and Dromtariffe recall Phoenix Park days of destiny|publisher=Echo Live|date=15 July 2024|accessdate=30 July 2026|first=|last=}}{{cite news|url=https://www.irishexaminer.com/sport-columnists/arid-41429941.html|title=Paul Rouse: In 1893 All-Ireland final, Cork robbed by Dublin ref: same as it ever was...|publisher=Echo Live|date=5 July 2024|accessdate=30 July 2026|first=|last=}} ==Participating teams== {| class="wikitable" |- !rowspan="2"|County !rowspan="2"|Club !colspan="2"|Most recent success !rowspan="2"| |- !All-Ireland !Provincial |- |[[Cork GAA|Cork]] |[[Blackrock GAA|Blackrock]] |[[1892 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|1892]] |[[1892 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship#Munster Senior Hurling Championship|1892]] |{{cite web|url=https://hoganstand.com/Cork/ClubTitles|title=Club Titles -
